request._comment: Transit parameter, consumed by this capacity. It may arrive as a value or as a transit reference; the contract declares only its name and schema (/root/llm/schema/request), and it is read through the parameter resolver.

response._comment: Transit result, consumed by the caller (/root/llm/schema/response). Never persisted by this capacity.

#adapt_request.role: Build the Mistral Chat Completions request from the canonical request.

transformation_contract.morphing: A canonical inference request becomes a Mistral chat-completion request.
notes: request.messages -> body.messages preserving role, content and order.
request.requirements.reasoning -> body.reasoning_effort when present and supported by the selected model.
When request.output.format is absent or 'text', response_format may be omitted or set to {"type":"text"}.
When request.output.format is 'json_schema', body.response_format uses Mistral JSON-schema mode with request.output.schema as the supplied schema.
No provider-specific field is exposed back into the canonical request.

#execute.role: Execute the Mistral chat-completion request asynchronously.

transformation_contract.morphing: A Mistral chat-completion request becomes a Mistral chat-completion response.

#normalize_response.role: Normalize the Mistral chat-completion response into /root/llm/schema/response.

transformation_contract.morphing: A Mistral chat-completion response becomes a canonical inference response.
notes: If the content is a list of content chunks, collect textual chunks in their returned order.
For format 'text', response.output.content preserves the generated text.
For format 'json' or 'json_schema', parse the returned JSON string into response.output.content.
response.output.format is the effective canonical output format.

#root.role: Adapt a canonical LLM request to the Mistral Chat Completions API, execute it asynchronously, and normalize the result.

invariants: The request and the response are transit values: no Matter is read, written or created, and nothing is persisted.

A transient failure of the provider (a rate limit 429, an overload 529, a server error 5xx, a request timeout 408, a broken connection) is asked again up to three times, waiting longer each time (the Retry-After of the provider when it gives one); any other error is returned at once.
transformation_contract.morphing: A canonical inference request becomes a canonical inference response produced through Mistral.

objective.name: infer.mistral
objective.description: Execute a canonical inference request through the Mistral Chat Completions API and return a canonical inference response.
